_about: Level-link numbers. A stair flight is walked and relabelled (game/endless.rs relabel), never interacted with; a sewer ladder is climbed by hand (game/ladder.rs). Read by game/transition.rs. prefetch_distance (the key keeps its historic name) is the residency radius (cells): how close the runner gets to a stair or ladder landing before the storey it leads to is kept resident (Game::keep_stack), so crossing builds nothing. Godot reference: game/world/generation/stairwells.gd, game/infinite_route/infinite_route_test.gd (_update_player_ladder).
